articles.summary: Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, today announced that Russell Diez-Canseco, President and Chief Executive Officer, Thilo Wrede, Chief Financial Officer, and Brian Shipman, Vice President of Investor Relations, will participate in the 28 th Annual ICR Conference in Orlando, FL on Monday, January 12 and Tuesday, January 13, 2026. Vital Farms will be available for 1x1 meetings and will host a fireside chat beginning at 2:30 p.m. Eastern Time on Monday, January 12, 2026. The webcast for the fireside chat will be available under the “Events Presentations” tab of the Vital Farms Investor Relations site at: https://investors.vitalfarms.com/investor-relations . ABOUT VITAL FARMS Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) is a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide.
